headline: UK Restarts Tank Barrel Manufacturing After 20-Year Hiatus
summary: The United Kingdom has resumed domestic production of tank barrels after 20 years, with the defence secretary announcing that the country has returned to manufacturing weapons for its military.
why: Sovereign defence industrial capacity is a strategic priority across European nations seeking to secure military supply chains amid regional security concerns.

impacts.name: UK Defence
impacts.why: Reviving domestic weapons manufacturing redirects procurement expenditure toward domestic defence suppliers.
